what_it_does.OFFLINE (CPU, any host): loads MAPPO u0 extended with v2v+intent (v2v_model.load_checkpoint, zero-init at v2v_obs.V2V_DIM=24), builds the STATISTICALLY FILTERED bank (replay_bank.bank_pairs under the bank v2 rule bank_statistics.view via a transient process-local adapter, restored immediately), runs ONE fixed update = one registered full-pass imitation run (bank_imitation.run, >=5 passes) and records the offline gate fields: passes, final joint KL (limit .045 imported from the runner report, never re-stated), cooperative-pair error change (paired per-pair cluster bootstrap 95% CI, seed 20261101), intent-pair error change (pairs whose context carries a present partner bit), partner-intent weight movement (the zero-initialised v2v columns of actor/critic).
what_it_does.PLAN: certifies candidates with the bank v2 rule (cooperative = replicated Student-t synergy CI lower > 0), REQUIRES the mandatory states 986066, 986048, 986003 (+ includes every newly certified cooperative state), and plans the ISOLATED policy-synergy branches via the existing policy_synergy.specs_for(isolated=True) (group-only NEW / one SOLO NEW per member / background-only NEW; all other CAVs u3; captured t0 action retained; intervention t0+1) PLUS the SECOND-SEED solo branches (replay_bank.replicate salt, _seed2 ids). Writes sealed COOPFIX_EXACT_PLAN.json, per-job sealed spec jsons (policy_synergy format, branch_sha256) and per-job SNAPSHOT.pt under control/jobs/.
what_it_does.EXECUTE (cpuQ only, never on this laptop: runs every planned branch through the EXISTING policy_synergy.BranchRunner behind bank_v2v.enabled(v2v), one branch at a time, no retry, writing sumo_verify.run_branch graded receipts (.graded.json).
what_it_does.COLLECT: consumes the job outputs (.graded.json, or raw BranchRunner .result.json regraded through sumo_verify.run_branch with the stored snapshot - prefix check included; no new SUMO wrapper), and writes sealed COOPFIX_GATE.json with per state: group-only gain, best solo, synergy (gain - best solo), per-vehicle paired bootstrap 95% CI over the two paired seeds plus the registered two-seed Student-t CI (bank_statistics.replicated_ci), background-only delta, ungraded branches; plus the offline gate fields and the verdict.

verdict: PASS iff the four offline checks pass (full_pass, kl_within_limit, cooperative_error_falls CI entirely below 0, partner_intent_weights_moved) AND the group-only synergy 95% CI lower bound > 0 on the 6-CAV state 986066 (which requires its two-seed solo replication graded). Every failure is disclosed in report['reasons']; no hand-set behavioural thresholds (the caps are the registered isolated-diagnostic budget rules).

registered_caps_respected.per_state: n<=6 group members, window end <= 1200 s, (n+2) isolated branches <= 9600 sim-s (isolated diagnostic registration MAIN2026-11-03 12:26); the plan REFUSES (before any physics) on violation
registered_caps_respected.second_seed_cost: the n seed-2 solo branches are quoted separately (seed2_solo_quote) and included in the plan totals; nothing is charged or run on this laptop

cost_in_sim_s.formula: per state: isolated (n+2)*window_end_s + second-seed solos n*window_end_s = (2n+2)*window_end_s; exact per-state sim-s is quoted in COOPFIX_EXACT_PLAN.json before any execution
